title: Tri poslanika u Skupštini Srbije podnijela ostavke
Three MPs in Serbia's Assembly have resigned
body: Tri poslanika u Narodnoj skupštini Srbije podnijela su ostavke, a među njima je i Dejan Bodiroga.
Three MPs in the National Assembly of Serbia have resigned, and Dejan Bodiroga is among them.
Osim njega, ostavke su dali Marko Korać i Dženan Palamar.
Apart from him, Marko Korać and Dženan Palamar resigned.
O ostavkama će u ponedjeljak raspravljati jedan skupštinski odbor.
An Assembly committee will discuss the resignations on Monday.
Korać je ostavku podnio 17. novembra, a Palamar dva dana kasnije, 19. novembra.
Korać submitted his resignation on 17 November, and Palamar two days later, on 19 November.
Bodiroga je to uradio danas, 27. novembra.
Bodiroga did it today, 27 November.
Ostavke su prva tačka dnevnog reda sjednice odbora.
The resignations are the first item on the agenda of the committee session.
Poziv za sjednicu potpisao je predsjednik odbora Stanko Fuštar.
The invitation to the session was signed by the committee chair Stanko Fuštar.
Odbor će razgovarati i o drugim temama.
The committee will also talk about other topics.
Jedna od njih je zahtjev poslanika Ahmedina Škrijelja za stan u Beogradu.
One of them is MP Ahmedin Škrijelj's request for an apartment in Belgrade.
On traži i novac jer živi odvojeno od porodice.
He is also asking for money because he lives apart from his family.

title: Snimak Lidije Vukićević iz Skupštine izazvao mnogo šala
A video of Lidija Vukićević from the Assembly caused many jokes
body: Srpska glumica i poslanica Lidija Vukićević postala je tema mnogih šala na društvenim mrežama.
Serbian actress and MP Lidija Vukićević has become the subject of many jokes on social media.
Na snimku se vidi kako izlazi iz Narodne skupštine Srbije zajedno s kolegama Branislavom Lečićem i Jelenom Đukić.
The video shows her leaving the National Assembly of Serbia together with colleagues Branislav Lečić and Jelena Đukić.
Ona je poslanica Srpske napredne stranke.
She is an MP of the Serbian Progressive Party.
Korisnici mreže X pisali su smiješne komentare, na primjer: „Otvara se kasa broj tri”.
Users of the X network wrote funny comments, for example: "Till number three is opening".
Neki su kritikovali i njenu odjeću, jer su mislili da uska kožna suknja nije za Skupštinu.
Some also criticised her clothes, because they thought a tight leather skirt is not for the Assembly.
Jedan korisnik napisao je da se i u dobroj kafani ljudi bolje obuku.
One user wrote that people dress better even in a good tavern.
Prema riječima Aleksandra Vučića, poslanici su izašli iz sale nakon pauze od deset minuta.
According to Aleksandar Vučić, the MPs left the hall after a ten-minute break.
Otišli su u policijsku stanicu Voždovac u Beogradu.
They went to the Voždovac police station in Belgrade.
Tamo su htjeli podržati urednika Informera Dragana J. Vučićevića, koji je uhapšen.
There they wanted to support the editor of Informer, Dragan J. Vučićević, who was arrested.

title: UEFA kaznila savez BiH zbog rasizma navijača u Zenici
UEFA punished the BiH association for fans' racism in Zenica
body: UEFA je kaznila Nogometni savez BiH zbog ponašanja navijača na utakmici protiv Rumunije.
UEFA punished the Football Association of BiH for the behaviour of fans at the match against Romania.
Reprezentacija BiH je 17. novembra na stadionu Bilino polje u Zenici pobijedila Rumuniju 2:1.
On 17 November the BiH national team beat Romania 2:1 at the Bilino polje stadium in Zenica.
U 72. minuti igra je kratko prekinuta jer su navijači BiH rasistički vrijeđali rumunske igrače.
In the 72nd minute play was briefly stopped because BiH fans racially insulted the Romanian players.
Savez mora platiti ukupno 30.000 eura kazne.
The association must pay a total of 30,000 euros in fines.
Za rasizam je kazna 20.000 eura, a za ometanje himni još 10.000 eura.
The fine for racism is 20,000 euros, and another 10,000 euros for disrupting the anthems.
Na sljedećoj domaćoj utakmici u takmičenjima UEFA-e bit će zatvoreno 5 posto mjesta na stadionu.
At the next home match in UEFA competitions 5 percent of the seats at the stadium will be closed.
Ta kazna je ostala od ranije, nakon rasizma navijača na utakmici protiv Poljske.
That penalty remained from earlier, after fans' racism at the match against Poland.
UEFA je dala i novu uslovnu kaznu od 5 posto mjesta, koja važi dvije godine.
UEFA also gave a new conditional penalty of 5 percent of the seats, which is valid for two years.
Ona će se primijeniti samo ako navijači ponovo urade nešto slično.
It will only be applied if fans do something similar again.
Ovo je već četvrta kazna UEFA-e za savez BiH ove jeseni.
This is already UEFA's fourth penalty for the BiH association this autumn.

title: BHRT novcem od RTRS-a uplatio doprinose bivšim radnicima
BHRT used money from RTRS to pay contributions for former workers
body: Radiotelevizija BiH uplatila je doprinose za sve bivše radnike koji su do 2026. godine stekli pravo na penziju.
Radio-Television of BiH has paid contributions for all former workers who gained the right to a pension by 2026.
Novac je došao od dvije konačne sudske presude koje je BHRT dobio protiv RTRS-a.
The money came from two final court judgments that BHRT won against RTRS.
O tome je uprava obavijestila radnike, a obavijest je objavila Pejka Medić, bivša direktorica BH Radija 1.
Management informed the workers about this, and the notice was published by Pejka Medić, former director of BH Radio 1.
U obavijesti nije navedeno koliko je novca uplaćeno ni koliko ljudi je dobilo doprinose.
The notice did not say how much money was paid or how many people received the contributions.
Uprava kaže da će plaćati doprinose i za radnike koji će kasnije steći pravo na penziju.
Management says it will also pay contributions for workers who gain the right to a pension later.
Očekuje novac i od drugih presuda i postupaka protiv RTRS-a koji su još u toku.
It expects money from other judgments and proceedings against RTRS that are still ongoing.
Ako bude dovoljno novca, BHRT bi postepeno počeo plaćati doprinose i za sadašnje radnike.
If there is enough money, BHRT would gradually start paying contributions for current workers too.
BHRT i RTRS se godinama spore na sudu oko podjele novca od RTV takse.
BHRT and RTRS have been in a court dispute for years over the division of money from the RTV fee.
U septembru je Vrhovni sud RS-a dao pravo BHRT-u, a računi RTRS-a ponovo su blokirani.
In September the Supreme Court of RS ruled in favour of BHRT, and the accounts of RTRS were blocked again.
Početkom novembra sud u Banjoj Luci djelimično je deblokirao račune, kako bi radnici RTRS-a dobili dvije plate.
At the start of November a court in Banja Luka partly unblocked the accounts so that RTRS workers would receive two salaries.

title: Završeno snimanje novog filma „Gospodar prstenova: Lov na Golluma”
Filming of the new film "The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum" has finished
body: Na Novom Zelandu završeno je snimanje filma „Gospodar prstenova: Lov na Golluma”.
Filming of "The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum" has finished in New Zealand.
Studio Warner Bros. objavio je vijest u šaljivom videu na društvenim mrežama.
The Warner Bros. studio announced the news in a funny video on social media.
U videu Gollum sedmicu nakon kraja snimanja ne želi izaći iz svoje prikolice, jer se navikao na udoban život.
In the video, a week after the end of filming, Gollum does not want to leave his trailer, because he has got used to a comfortable life.
Film je režirao Andy Serkis, koji ponovo igra Golluma, a producent je Peter Jackson.
The film was directed by Andy Serkis, who plays Gollum again, and the producer is Peter Jackson.
Elijah Wood se vraća kao Frodo, a Ian McKellen kao Gandalf.
Elijah Wood returns as Frodo, and Ian McKellen as Gandalf.
Aragorna igra Jamie Dornan, a u filmu su i Anya Taylor-Joy, Kate Winslet i Leo Woodall.
Aragorn is played by Jamie Dornan, and Anya Taylor-Joy, Kate Winslet and Leo Woodall are also in the film.
Film bi trebao doći u kina 17. decembra 2027. godine.
The film should come to cinemas on 17 December 2027.
Priča prati Aragorna dok traži Golluma, prije nego što Gollum Sauronu otkrije gdje je Prsten.
The story follows Aragorn as he searches for Gollum, before Gollum reveals to Sauron where the Ring is.
Radnja se dešava između događaja iz „Hobita” i „Prstena zajedništva”.
The plot takes place between the events of "The Hobbit" and "The Fellowship of the Ring".
Gollum je nekada bio hobit Sméagol, a Prsten je čuvao skoro 500 godina.
Gollum was once a hobbit, Sméagol, and he kept the Ring for almost 500 years.

title: RS daje još novca svojim uredima u Washingtonu i Beču
RS gives more money to its offices in Washington and Vienna
body: Vlada Republike Srpske ponovo je promijenila kako dijeli novac svojim predstavništvima u inostranstvu za 2026. godinu.
The Government of Republika Srpska has again changed how it divides money among its representative offices abroad for 2026.
Odluku je donijela na sjednici 19. novembra, a danas je objavljena u Službenom glasniku RS-a.
It made the decision at a session on 19 November, and today it was published in the Official Gazette of RS.
Ukupan iznos ostao je isti, 65,75 miliona KM, ali ured u Washingtonu dobija još 1 milion KM.
The total amount stayed the same, 65.75 million KM, but the office in Washington gets another 1 million KM.
Ured u Washingtonu sada ima 3,08 miliona KM, što je oko 48 posto više nego u oktobru.
The office in Washington now has 3.08 million KM, which is about 48 percent more than in October.
Ured u Beču dobio je još 500 hiljada KM i ima 32,22 miliona KM, skoro polovinu cijelog iznosa.
The office in Vienna got another 500 thousand KM and has 32.22 million KM, almost half of the whole amount.
Više novca dobili su i uredi u Moskvi, Stuttgartu i Beogradu.
The offices in Moscow, Stuttgart and Belgrade also got more money.
Vlada nije objasnila zašto je promijenila podjelu ni na šta će uredi trošiti novac.
The government did not explain why it changed the division or what the offices will spend the money on.
Ured u Beču je 2025. godine potpisao ugovor s jednim kanadskim konsultantom, a jedan od ciljeva bio je nezavisnost RS-a.
In 2025 the office in Vienna signed a contract with a Canadian consultant, and one of the goals was the independence of RS.
Ustavni sud BiH je 24. septembra zabranio sva plaćanja iz budžeta RS-a po tom ugovoru.
On 24 September the Constitutional Court of BiH banned all payments from the RS budget under that contract.
Milorad Dodik je tada rekao da sud neće odlučivati za šta će RS trošiti novac.
Milorad Dodik said at the time that the court will not decide what RS will spend money on.
Iz objavljenih odluka ne vidi se da li dio novca ide za lobiranje.
The published decisions do not show whether part of the money goes to lobbying.

title: Vico Zeljković se izvinio zbog napada svog oca na sudiju
Vico Zeljković apologised for his father's attack on the referee
body: Predsjednik Nogometnog saveza BiH Vico Zeljković izvinio se nakon skandala koji je izazvao njegov otac.
The president of the Football Association of BiH, Vico Zeljković, apologised after a scandal caused by his father.
Izjavu je objavio na Facebooku, a izvinio se sudiji i sportskoj javnosti.
He published the statement on Facebook, and he apologised to the referee and the sports public.
Incident se desio nakon utakmice Konferencijske lige između Borca i Atalante u Banjoj Luci.
The incident happened after the Conference League match between Borac and Atalanta in Banja Luka.
Atalanta je na Gradskom stadionu pobijedila rezultatom 3:2.
Atalanta won 3:2 at the City Stadium.
Nakon utakmice belgijski sudija Nathan Verboomen išao je sa svojim pomoćnicima prema tunelu.
After the match the Belgian referee Nathan Verboomen was walking with his assistants towards the tunnel.
Tada mu je prišao Spasoje Zeljković, prijetio mu rukom i udario ga u leđa.
Then Spasoje Zeljković came up to him, threatened him with his hand and hit him in the back.
Reagovalo je obezbjeđenje, a on se posvađao i s trenerom Atalante Mauriziom Sarrijem.
Security reacted, and he also argued with Atalanta's coach Maurizio Sarri.
Zeljković je rekao da porodične veze i njegova funkcija ne mogu opravdati nikakvu povlasticu.
Zeljković said that family ties and his position cannot justify any privilege.
Dodao je da je svako odgovoran za svoje postupke, čak i njegovi najbliži.
He added that everyone is responsible for their own actions, even his closest family.
Prema njegovim riječima, poštovanje pravila u nogometu nema alternativu.
According to him, respect for the rules in football has no alternative.
Borcu sada prijeti kazna UEFA-e zbog ovog incidenta.
Borac now faces a UEFA penalty because of this incident.

title: Sjemenke bundeve mogu biti dobre za zdravlje srca
Pumpkin seeds can be good for heart health
body: Sjemenke bundeve imaju mnogo magnezija, proteina, vlakana i nezasićenih masti.
Pumpkin seeds have a lot of magnesium, protein, fibre and unsaturated fats.
Zato mogu biti dio prehrane koja pomaže zdravlju srca.
That is why they can be part of a diet that helps heart health.
Magnezij je važan za rad mišića i nerava, krvni pritisak i normalan rad srca.
Magnesium is important for the work of muscles and nerves, blood pressure and normal heart function.
Turski naučnici objavili su 28. oktobra istraživanje sa 107 odraslih osoba koje imaju višak kilograma.
On 28 October Turkish scientists published a study with 107 adults who are overweight.
Program od četiri sedmice završilo je 89 ljudi.
89 people finished the four-week programme.
Jedna grupa jela je 30 grama sjemenki dnevno, druga je uzimala 15 grama ulja od bundeve, a treća je samo promijenila prehranu.
One group ate 30 grams of seeds a day, the second took 15 grams of pumpkin oil, and the third only changed its diet.
Masnoće u krvi su se smanjile u prve dvije grupe, ali razlika između grupa nije bila velika.
Fats in the blood decreased in the first two groups, but the difference between the groups was not big.
Naučnici kažu da su potrebna nova istraživanja.
The scientists say that new studies are needed.
Sjemenke možete dodati u zobene pahuljice, jogurt, salatu ili supu.
You can add the seeds to oatmeal, yogurt, salad or soup.
Bolje je birati one bez soli i paziti na količinu, jer imaju mnogo kalorija.
It is better to choose ones without salt and to watch the amount, because they have a lot of calories.
Sjemenke nisu lijek za visok holesterol ili pritisak.
Seeds are not a cure for high cholesterol or blood pressure.

title: Najduži podvodni cestovni tunel prošao ispod rijeke Jangce
The longest underwater road tunnel passed under the Yangtze River
body: U Kini je jedna cijev najdužeg podvodnog cestovnog tunela na svijetu prošla ispod rijeke Jangce.
In China one tube of the world's longest underwater road tunnel has passed under the Yangtze River.
Mašina za kopanje Jianghai stigla je do južne obale nakon 14 mjeseci rada.
The boring machine Jianghai reached the south bank after 14 months of work.
Ispod korita rijeke iskopala je 7,46 kilometara.
It dug 7.46 kilometres under the riverbed.
Tunel Haitai povezuje gradove Haimen i Taicang u provinciji Jiangsu, na istoku Kine.
The Haitai tunnel connects the cities of Haimen and Taicang in Jiangsu province, in eastern China.
Dug je oko 39 kilometara, a od toga je 11,185 kilometara pod vodom.
It is about 39 kilometres long, and 11.185 kilometres of that is under water.
Mašina teži više od 5.000 tona i u prosjeku je kopala oko 20 metara dnevno.
The machine weighs more than 5,000 tons and dug about 20 metres a day on average.
Najdublja tačka tunela je 75 metara ispod površine.
The deepest point of the tunnel is 75 metres below the surface.
Tunel će imati šest traka, tri u svakom smjeru, a vozila će voziti do 100 kilometara na sat.
The tunnel will have six lanes, three in each direction, and vehicles will drive up to 100 kilometres per hour.
Gradnja je počela u septembru 2022. godine, a tunel bi trebao biti otvoren 2028.
Construction began in September 2022, and the tunnel should be opened in 2028.
Prema riječima inženjera, najveći problemi bili su visok pritisak vode i teško tlo.
According to the engineers, the biggest problems were high water pressure and difficult ground.
Tunel bi trebao smanjiti gužve na jednom mostu i skratiti put do Šangaja.
The tunnel should reduce traffic jams on one bridge and shorten the trip to Shanghai.

title: Arapska stranka mogla bi pomoći da Netanyahu ostane bez vlasti
An Arab party could help Netanyahu lose power
body: Mansour Abbas, lider arapske stranke Ra'am u Izraelu, mogao bi pomoći da se formira nova vlada bez Benjamina Netanyahua.
Mansour Abbas, the leader of the Arab party Ra'am in Israel, could help form a new government without Benjamin Netanyahu.
Izraelski mediji pišu da će Abbas u subotu navečer dati intervju za Kanal 12.
Israeli media write that Abbas will give an interview to Channel 12 on Saturday evening.
U tom intervjuu mogao bi prvi put reći da je Hamas teroristička organizacija.
In that interview he could say for the first time that Hamas is a terrorist organisation.
To je glavni uslov koji je postavio Gadi Eisenkot, političar koji pokušava sastaviti novu vladu.
That is the main condition set by Gadi Eisenkot, the politician who is trying to put together a new government.
Eisenkot ima još 9 dana prije nego što mu istekne mandat za formiranje vlade.
Eisenkot has 9 more days before his mandate to form a government expires.
Abbas je do sada osuđivao napade, uključujući napad Hamasa od 7. oktobra 2023. godine, ali Hamas nije nazivao terorističkim.
Until now Abbas has condemned attacks, including the Hamas attack of 7 October 2023, but he did not call Hamas terrorist.
Ra'am je već bio u vladi od 2021. do 2022. godine, što je rijetko za arapsku stranku.
Ra'am was already in government from 2021 to 2022, which is rare for an Arab party.
Abbas je na radiju rekao da stranka neće blokirati novu vladu ako se od prvog dana brine o pravima Arapa.
Abbas said on the radio that the party will not block the new government if it takes care of the rights of Arabs from the first day.
Kada ga je novinarka pitala da li je spreman da zbog toga riskira život, odgovorio je da se pomirio s tim.
When the journalist asked him whether he was ready to risk his life because of it, he answered that he had accepted it.
Ako Ra'am uđe u vladu, Eisenkot bi mogao imati dovoljno glasova da Netanyahu više ne bude premijer.
If Ra'am enters the government, Eisenkot could have enough votes so that Netanyahu is no longer prime minister.

title: Navijači Atalante satima čekali ispred stadiona u Banjoj Luci
Atalanta fans waited for hours in front of the stadium in Banja Luka
body: Italijanski mediji pišu da većina navijača Atalante nije vidjela centar Banje Luke.
Italian media write that most Atalanta fans did not see the centre of Banja Luka.
Ti navijači su prije utakmice protiv Borca satima čekali ispred stadiona.
Those fans waited for hours in front of the stadium before the match against Borac.
Vijest je objavio italijanski portal TuttoAtalanta.
The news was published by the Italian portal TuttoAtalanta.
Na utakmicu u Banju Luku došlo je 494 navijača iz Italije.
494 fans from Italy came to the match in Banja Luka.
Neki od njih su dugo čekali i na hrvatskoj granici zbog kontrole.
Some of them also waited a long time at the Croatian border because of checks.
Problema nisu imali samo oni koji su putovali sami ili su stigli dan ranije.
The only ones who had no problems were those who travelled on their own or arrived a day earlier.
Svih 12.000 ulaznica za utakmicu Konferencijske lige bilo je prodano.
All 12,000 tickets for the Conference League match were sold.
Ipak, portal piše da u gradu nije bilo velikog oduševljenja prije dolaska Atalante.
Still, the portal writes that there was no great excitement in the city before Atalanta's arrival.
Atalanta je na kraju pobijedila rezultatom 3:2, iako je Borac dugo vodio.
In the end Atalanta won 3:2, although Borac led for a long time.
Jedan od golova za italijanski klub zabio je Sead Kolašinac.
One of the goals for the Italian club was scored by Sead Kolašinac.

title: Automobili u Istri vozili preko poplavljenog mosta
Cars in Istria drove across a flooded bridge
body: Na društvenim mrežama pojavio se neobičan snimak iz Istre u Hrvatskoj.
An unusual video from Istria in Croatia has appeared on social networks.
Na njemu se vidi kako automobili voze preko mosta Antenal, koji je bio pod vodom.
It shows cars driving across the Antenal bridge, which was under water.
Snimak je napravljen u četvrtak, a prvi je o njemu pisao portal Index.hr.
The video was made on Thursday, and the portal Index.hr was the first to write about it.
Most se nalazi blizu mjesta gdje rijeka Mirna utiče u more.
The bridge is located near the place where the river Mirna flows into the sea.
Preko njega ide državni put između Novigrada i Poreča.
A state road between Novigrad and Poreč goes over it.
Voda je bila sa svih strana ceste, pa izgleda kao da automobili voze po moru.
There was water on all sides of the road, so it looks as if the cars are driving on the sea.
Zbog visokog nivoa mora i vode, put se na tom mjestu ponekad potpuno zatvara.
Because of the high level of the sea and water, the road is sometimes completely closed at that spot.
Istru je ovog mjeseca pogodilo mnogo jake kiše.
A lot of heavy rain has hit Istria this month.
Hrvatski autoklub upozorava vozače da na cesti može ostati vode.
The Croatian Automobile Club warns drivers that water may remain on the road.
Savjetuje im da voze sporije i pažljivo, prema uslovima na putu.
It advises them to drive more slowly and carefully, according to the conditions on the road.

title: Radnik Elektro-Bijeljine uhapšen u Mađarskoj sa službenim autom
An Elektro-Bijeljina worker was arrested in Hungary with a company car
body: Radnik kompanije Elektro-Bijeljina uhapšen je u Mađarskoj dok je vozio službeno vozilo.
A worker of the company Elektro-Bijeljina was arrested in Hungary while he was driving a company vehicle.
Policija u Bijeljini u četvrtak je pretresla prostorije koje je koristio taj radnik, S. S.
On Thursday police in Bijeljina searched the premises that this worker, S. S., used.
Policija kaže da nije pronašla ništa što bi upućivalo na krivično djelo.
The police say they found nothing that would point to a criminal offence.
Kompanija je saopćila da je prijavila nestanak službenog auta.
The company announced that it had reported the company car missing.
Radnik je, kako kažu, uzeo auto bez odobrenja i nije ga vratio.
The worker, they say, took the car without permission and did not return it.
Gradonačelnik Bijeljine Ljubiša Petrović tvrdi da je mađarska policija u autu pronašla veliku količinu kokaina.
The mayor of Bijeljina, Ljubiša Petrović, claims that the Hungarian police found a large amount of cocaine in the car.
Opozicioni lider Nebojša Vukanović rekao je da je riječ o 5 kilograma kokaina.
Opposition leader Nebojša Vukanović said it was 5 kilograms of cocaine.
Vukanović procjenjuje da bi ta droga vrijedila oko 850.000 KM.
Vukanović estimates that this drug would be worth around 850,000 KM.
Nijedna institucija još nije zvanično potvrdila da je u autu bila droga.
No institution has yet officially confirmed that there were drugs in the car.
Direktor kompanije Bojan Savić kaže da uhapšeni čovjek nije bio njegov vozač.
The director of the company, Bojan Savić, says the arrested man was not his driver.

title: SDP u Sarajevu obećava da neće blokirati rad Skupštine
SDP in Sarajevo promises it will not block the Assembly's work
body: Skupština Kantona Sarajevo danas je izabrala novo rukovodstvo i tako počela novi saziv.
The Sarajevo Canton Assembly elected a new leadership today and so began a new term.
Nakon sjednice, SDP Kantona Sarajevo poslao je saopćenje za javnost.
After the session, SDP of Sarajevo Canton sent out a press statement.
Stranka u njemu kaže da blokade u Skupštini neće biti.
In it, the party says there will be no blockades in the Assembly.
SDP će u novoj Skupštini imati 9 zastupnika.
SDP will have 9 representatives in the new Assembly.
Davor Čičić je novi predsjedavajući Skupštine, a Jelena Pekić je jedna od zamjenika.
Davor Čičić is the new speaker of the Assembly, and Jelena Pekić is one of the deputies.
U klubu stranke su i Belma Kapo, Svjetlana Šošić, Vedrana Vikić, Selma Smajlović, Redžo Lemezan, Kenan Magoda i Predrag Puharić.
The party's club also includes Belma Kapo, Svjetlana Šošić, Vedrana Vikić, Selma Smajlović, Redžo Lemezan, Kenan Magoda and Predrag Puharić.
Iz SDP-a kažu da neće stavljati interese stranke ispred interesa građana.
SDP says it will not put the party's interests ahead of the interests of citizens.
Žele institucije koje funkcionišu, konkretna rješenja i bolji život za sve stanovnike kantona.
They want institutions that work, concrete solutions and a better life for all residents of the canton.
Stranka je poručila da će podržati svaku odluku koja je u interesu građana.
The party said it will support every decision that is in the interest of citizens.
Na kraju su zahvalili glasačima i rekli da se odgovornost mjeri radom i rezultatima.
At the end they thanked voters and said that responsibility is measured by work and results.

title: Studenti u Srbiji izabrali kandidata za predsjednika
Students in Serbia chose a candidate for president
body: Studentska lista u Srbiji danas je zvanično predstavila Radomira Saičića kao svog kandidata za predsjednika.
The Student List in Serbia today officially presented Radomir Saičić as its candidate for president.
Predsjednički izbori u Srbiji održat će se 27. decembra.
The presidential election in Serbia will be held on 27 December.
Saičić je akademik, a kandidaturu je predstavio na konferenciji za medije.
Saičić is an academician, and he presented the candidacy at a press conference.
Studenti su rekli da odluka nije bila ni brza ni laka.
The students said the decision was neither quick nor easy.
Kažu da demokratija traži vrijeme, dijalog i pažljivo razmišljanje.
They say that democracy needs time, dialogue and careful thinking.
Prema njihovim riječima, snaga nije u jednom čovjeku nego u zajednici koja stoji iza zajedničkih ciljeva.
In their words, the strength is not in one person but in the community that stands behind common goals.
Saičić je rekao da se funkcija predsjednika godinama zloupotrebljavala da bi se ljudi dijelili.
Saičić said that the office of president had been misused for years to divide people.
Dodao je da predsjednik ne smije raditi više od onoga što mu dozvoljava ustav.
He added that the president must not do more than the constitution allows him.
Prema njegovim riječima, prošla vlast je stvarala lažne podjele u Crnoj Gori, Republici Srpskoj i drugdje.
According to him, the previous government created false divisions in Montenegro, Republika Srpska and elsewhere.
Rekao je da je cilj jedinstvo srpskog naroda, uz poštovanje država u kojima Srbi žive.
He said the goal is the unity of the Serb people, with respect for the states in which Serbs live.

title: Kritičari nisu zadovoljni novim filmom o porodici Focker
Critics are not happy with the new film about the Focker family
body: Novi film „Focker-In-Law“ razočarao je većinu filmskih kritičara.
The new film "Focker-In-Law" has disappointed most film critics.
To je četvrti film u seriji komedija koja je počela 2000. godine.
It is the fourth film in a series of comedies that began in 2000.
Kritičari hvale samo pjevačicu Arianu Grande, koja u filmu igra Oliviju Jones.
Critics only praise the singer Ariana Grande, who plays Olivia Jones in the film.
Na stranici Rotten Tomatoes film ima ocjenu 30 posto, na osnovu 87 kritika.
On the website Rotten Tomatoes the film has a score of 30 percent, based on 87 reviews.
Ben Stiller i Robert De Niro ponovo igraju glavne uloge, a s njima su Owen Wilson i Blythe Danner.
Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro play the main roles again, and Owen Wilson and Blythe Danner are with them.
Film je napisao i režirao John Hamburg.
The film was written and directed by John Hamburg.
Kritičari pišu da je Grande zabavna, ali da je cijeli film umoran.
Critics write that Grande is funny, but that the whole film is tired.
Donald Clarke iz Irish Timesa dao je filmu samo 1 od 5 zvjezdica.
Donald Clarke of the Irish Times gave the film only 1 out of 5 stars.
Rekao je da situacije postanu toliko neugodne da više nisu smiješne.
He said the situations become so uncomfortable that they are no longer funny.
Ni prethodni filmovi nisu dobro prošli, jer je onaj iz 2010. godine dobio samo 10 posto.
The previous films did not do well either, because the one from 2010 got only 10 percent.

title: Volvo uči humanoidne robote da rade u fabrici
Volvo is teaching humanoid robots to work in a factory
body: Volvo Cars je počeo obučavati humanoidne robote u svojoj fabrici u Gentu u Belgiji.
Volvo Cars has started training humanoid robots in its factory in Ghent in Belgium.
Humanoidni roboti su roboti koji po obliku liče na čovjeka.
Humanoid robots are robots that look like a human in shape.
Ako obuka uspije, roboti bi u proizvodnji mogli raditi od sredine 2027. godine.
If the training succeeds, the robots could work in production from the middle of 2027.
Robot se zove AEON, a napravila ga je švedska kompanija Hexagon.
The robot is called AEON, and it was made by the Swedish company Hexagon.
Visok je 1,65 metara, težak 60 kilograma i umjesto nogu ima točkove.
It is 1.65 metres tall, weighs 60 kilograms and has wheels instead of legs.
Može nositi do 10 kilograma i kretati se brzinom do 2,4 metra u sekundi.
It can carry up to 10 kilograms and move at a speed of up to 2.4 metres per second.
Roboti prvo uče da precizno stavljaju dijelove u držače, tako što gledaju i ponavljaju šta rade ljudi.
The robots first learn to put parts precisely into holders, by watching and repeating what people do.
Cilj je da roboti preuzmu poslove koji se ponavljaju i koji su fizički teški.
The goal is for the robots to take over jobs that are repetitive and physically hard.
Direktor proizvodnje Magnus Nilsson rekao je da se robot može lako uklopiti u postojeću proizvodnju.
Production director Magnus Nilsson said that the robot can easily fit into the existing production.
Ovaj robot ove godine testira i BMW u svojoj fabrici u Leipzigu.
BMW is also testing this robot this year in its factory in Leipzig.

title: Istraživanje o narandžama i masnoj jetri
A study on oranges and fatty liver
body: Novo istraživanje ispitalo je kako narandže djeluju na ljude koji imaju masnu jetru.
A new study examined how oranges affect people who have fatty liver.
Kod ove bolesti u jetri se skuplja previše masti, a često je povezana s viškom kilograma i dijabetesom tipa 2.
In this disease too much fat collects in the liver, and it is often linked with excess weight and type 2 diabetes.
Rezultati su objavljeni u naučnom časopisu Nutrients.
The results were published in the scientific journal Nutrients.
U istraživanju je učestvovalo 66 osoba, podijeljenih u dvije grupe.
66 people took part in the study, divided into two groups.
Jedna grupa je četiri sedmice svaki dan jela 400 grama narandži, a druga ih nije jela.
One group ate 400 grams of oranges every day for four weeks, and the other did not eat them.
Naučnici su pratili šećer u krvi, inzulin i druge vrijednosti.
The scientists monitored blood sugar, insulin and other values.
Ljudi koji su jeli narandže unosili su više vitamina C i A.
People who ate oranges took in more vitamins C and A.
Jedna vrijednost šećera u krvi lagano je pala, ali razlika nije bila dovoljno velika da bude sigurna.
One blood sugar value fell slightly, but the difference was not big enough to be certain.
Autori kažu da narandže imaju vlakna i druge tvari koje bi mogle biti dobre za metabolizam.
The authors say that oranges have fibre and other substances that could be good for metabolism.
Ipak, istraživanje je bilo malo i kratko, pa su potrebna veća istraživanja.
However, the study was small and short, so larger studies are needed.
Naučnici naglašavaju da narandže ne liječe masnu jetru i ne mogu zamijeniti terapiju.
The scientists stress that oranges do not cure fatty liver and cannot replace treatment.

title: Italijanski list stavio Banju Luku u Srbiju
Italian newspaper placed Banja Luka in Serbia
body: Italijanski mediji opširno su pisali o pobjedi Atalante protiv Borca u Banjoj Luci.
Italian media wrote extensively about Atalanta's victory against Borac in Banja Luka.
Atalanta je pobijedila 3:2, iako je Borac vodio 2:0 sve do 86. minute.
Atalanta won 3:2, although Borac was leading 2:0 until the 86th minute.
List Corriere dello Sport napravio je grešku i napisao da je Banja Luka u Srbiji.
The newspaper Corriere dello Sport made a mistake and wrote that Banja Luka is in Serbia.
Isti list je pisao o ludom preokretu za sedam minuta i hvalio Juričića.
The same newspaper wrote about a crazy comeback in seven minutes and praised Juričić.
Portal CalcioAtalanta piše da su domaći navijači zviždali Seadu Kolašincu.
The portal CalcioAtalanta writes that the home fans whistled at Sead Kolašinac.
Kolašinac je na početku imao nekoliko grešaka, ali je u 90. minuti izjednačio rezultat.
Kolašinac had several mistakes at the start, but in the 90th minute he levelled the score.
Eurosport je igračima Borca Deketu, Juričiću, Vukoviću i Cipetiću dao ocjenu 7.
Eurosport gave the Borac players Deket, Juričić, Vuković and Cipetić a mark of 7.
Prema Eurosportu, Atalanta je preokret napravila tek nakon što su dva igrača Borca dobila crveni karton.
According to Eurosport, Atalanta made the comeback only after two Borac players got a red card.
Atmosferu na Gradskom stadionu uporedili su s atmosferom na Bilinom polju u Zenici.
They compared the atmosphere at the City Stadium with the atmosphere at Bilino polje in Zenica.
Atalanta sada ima 7 bodova, a Borac 3.
Atalanta now has 7 points, and Borac 3.
Italijanski klub u ponedjeljak igra protiv Leccea u Seriji A.
On Monday the Italian club plays against Lecce in Serie A.

title: Snijeg i vjetar zatvorili puteve u Hrvatskoj
Snow and wind closed roads in Croatia
body: Snijeg i jak vjetar otežavaju saobraćaj u Hrvatskoj, javlja Hrvatski autoklub.
Snow and strong wind are making traffic difficult in Croatia, the Croatian Automobile Club reports.
Najteže je u Gorskom kotaru, Lici i Hrvatskom primorju.
It is hardest in Gorski kotar, Lika and the Croatian Littoral.
Vozači koji putuju u Hrvatsku moraju imati zimsku opremu.
Drivers who travel to Croatia must have winter equipment.
Kamioni s prikolicama i vozila bez zimske opreme ne smiju voziti dijelom autoceste od Zagreba prema Splitu.
Trucks with trailers and vehicles without winter equipment must not drive on part of the motorway from Zagreb to Split.
Ista zabrana važi i na autocesti prema Rijeci, kao i na mnogim cestama u Gorskom kotaru i Lici.
The same ban applies on the motorway towards Rijeka, as well as on many roads in Gorski kotar and Lika.
Za ta vozila trenutno nema otvorenog puta između unutrašnjosti i mora.
For these vehicles there is currently no open route between the interior and the sea.
Zbog vjetra su zabranjeni i motocikli i autobusi na kat na nekim dionicama kod Rijeke i Senja.
Because of the wind, motorcycles and double-decker buses are also banned on some sections near Rijeka and Senj.
Ceste su mokre i klizave, a na mostovima može biti leda.
The roads are wet and slippery, and there may be ice on bridges.
Na granici s BiH prijelaz Gunja–Brčko zatvoren je za kamione i autobuse, pa oni idu preko Županje i Orašja.
On the border with BiH the Gunja–Brčko crossing is closed to trucks and buses, so they go via Županja and Orašje.
Katamaran između Pule i Zadra ne vozi zbog vjetra.
The catamaran between Pula and Zadar is not running because of the wind.
Zimska oprema u Hrvatskoj obavezna je od 15. novembra do 15. aprila.
Winter equipment in Croatia is mandatory from 15 November to 15 April.

title: Juričić: Poraz od Atalante je najbolniji u mojoj karijeri
Juričić: The defeat to Atalanta is the most painful of my career
body: Napadač Borca Luka Juričić rekao je da je poraz od Atalante najbolniji u njegovoj karijeri.
Borac striker Luka Juričić said that the defeat to Atalanta is the most painful of his career.
Borac je u četvrtom kolu Konferencijske lige u Banjoj Luci izgubio 3:2, iako je vodio 2:0.
In the fourth round of the Conference League in Banja Luka, Borac lost 3:2, although it was leading 2:0.
Juričić je postigao prvi gol u 22. minuti, a Deket je povećao vodstvo u 30. minuti.
Juričić scored the first goal in the 22nd minute, and Deket increased the lead in the 30th minute.
Borac je kasnije dobio dva crvena kartona i završio utakmicu s dva igrača manje.
Borac later got two red cards and finished the match with two players fewer.
Atalanta je tada u samo nekoliko minuta postigla tri gola.
Atalanta then scored three goals in just a few minutes.
Golove su dali Krstović, Kolašinac i Zappacosta, a posljednji je pao u sudijskoj nadoknadi.
The goals were scored by Krstović, Kolašinac and Zappacosta, and the last one came in stoppage time.
Juričić je rekao da je Borac odigrao kvalitetnu utakmicu i da igrači mogu biti ponosni.
Juričić said that Borac played a quality match and that the players can be proud.
Smatra da je Atalanta jača ekipa, ali da se to nije vidjelo na terenu.
He believes that Atalanta is a stronger team, but that this was not seen on the pitch.
Borac ima tri boda, a do kraja su još dvije utakmice.
Borac has three points, and there are two more matches until the end.
Juričić vjeruje da bi oko četiri boda bila dovoljna za prolaz dalje.
Juričić believes that about four points would be enough to go through.
Borac u nedjelju igra protiv Sarajeva u Premijer ligi.
On Sunday Borac plays against Sarajevo in the Premier League.

title: Prva panda rođena u Indoneziji proslavila prvi rođendan
The first panda born in Indonesia celebrated its first birthday
body: Rio, prva velika panda rođena u Indoneziji, proslavio je prvi rođendan u parku Taman Safari kod grada Bogora.
Rio, the first giant panda born in Indonesia, celebrated his first birthday in the Taman Safari park near the city of Bogor.
Na proslavi se igrao s majkom Hu Chun među bambusom, dok su ga fotografi snimali iza ograde.
At the celebration he played with his mother Hu Chun among the bamboo, while photographers filmed him from behind the fence.
Prostor je bio ukrašen natpisom koji mu čestita rođendan.
The space was decorated with a sign congratulating him on his birthday.
Rio je rođen 27. novembra 2025. godine, a njegov otac se zove Cai Tao.
Rio was born on 27 November 2025, and his father's name is Cai Tao.
Roditelji su u Indoneziju stigli 2017. godine u okviru programa zaštite vrste s Kinom.
The parents arrived in Indonesia in 2017 as part of a species protection programme with China.
Ime Satrio Wiratama dao mu je predsjednik Prabowo Subianto, a ono znači plemeniti i hrabri vitez.
The name Satrio Wiratama was given to him by President Prabowo Subianto, and it means noble and brave knight.
Put do Riovog rođenja bio je dug i težak.
The path to Rio's birth was long and difficult.
Stručnjaci su prvo četiri puta pokušali prirodnim putem, a onda su prešli na vještačku oplodnju.
Experts first tried four times naturally, and then switched to artificial insemination.
Uspjeli su tek u četvrtom pokušaju.
They succeeded only on the fourth attempt.
Posjetioci mogu vidjeti Rija uživo od 9. juna ove godine, kada je predstavljen javnosti.
Visitors can see Rio live since 9 June this year, when he was presented to the public.

title: Dodik kaže da je veći patriota od studenata u Srbiji
Dodik says he is a bigger patriot than the students in Serbia
body: Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik odbacio je kritike studenata iz Srbije koji se okupljaju oko Studentske liste.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik rejected criticism from students in Serbia who gather around the Student List.
U intervjuu za Euronews Srbija, snimljenom u Banjoj Luci, rekao je da je veći patriota od njih.
In an interview with Euronews Srbija, recorded in Banja Luka, he said he is a bigger patriot than they are.
Dodao je da se zbog toga neće pravdati ni u Srbiji ni u Republici Srpskoj.
He added that he will not justify himself for it either in Serbia or in Republika Srpska.
Mediji su ranije pisali da studenti prije izbora u Srbiji nisu mogli održati skupove u Banjoj Luci.
The media earlier wrote that before the elections in Serbia the students could not hold rallies in Banja Luka.
Dodik tvrdi da im niko nije zabranio skupove, a organizatori nisu tražili odobrenje policije.
Dodik claims that no one banned their rallies, and the organisers did not ask the police for approval.
Priznao je da nije pročitao program Studentske liste kada je pozivao građane da glasaju protiv nje.
He admitted that he had not read the Student List's programme when he called on citizens to vote against it.
Neki dijelovi programa su mu prihvatljivi, ali za druge kaže da ih tek treba razumjeti.
Some parts of the programme are acceptable to him, but about others he says they still need to be understood.
Novim vlastima u Srbiji poručio je da ne diraju Republiku Srpsku.
He told the new authorities in Serbia not to touch Republika Srpska.
Rekao je i da nema plan za odcjepljenje od Bosne i Hercegovine.
He also said that he has no plan for secession from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Ipak, smatra da Srbi nemaju razlog ostati u zajednici u kojoj, kako kaže, ne mogu koristiti prava iz Dejtonskog sporazuma.
Still, he believes that Serbs have no reason to stay in a community in which, as he says, they cannot use the rights from the Dayton Agreement.
Na kraju je rekao da bi Aleksandar Vučić trebao studentima dati priliku da rade.
Finally, he said that Aleksandar Vučić should give the students a chance to work.

title: Glumac Jonathan Frakes govorio o borbi s rakom
Actor Jonathan Frakes spoke about his fight with cancer
body: Američki glumac Jonathan Frakes, poznat iz serije Zvjezdane staze, ispričao je kako je saznao da ima rak mokraćnog mjehura.
American actor Jonathan Frakes, known from the series Star Trek, told how he found out that he has bladder cancer.
Frakes ima 74 godine, a o bolesti je govorio u podcastu koji je objavljen 21. novembra.
Frakes is 74 years old, and he talked about the illness in a podcast that was released on 21 November.
Jedne večeri primijetio je da mu je urin ružičaste boje.
One evening he noticed that his urine was pink.
Prvo je mislio da je to zbog cvekle, ali mu je kolega Brent Spiner rekao da ode doktoru.
At first he thought it was because of beetroot, but his colleague Brent Spiner told him to go to a doctor.
Urolog mu je uradio cistoskopiju, pregled mjehura malom kamerom, i pronašao rak.
A urologist did a cystoscopy on him, an examination of the bladder with a small camera, and found cancer.
Tri dana kasnije doktori su operacijom uklonili tumore.
Three days later doctors removed the tumours with an operation.
Nakon toga je šest sedmica primao hemoterapiju i imunoterapiju.
After that he received chemotherapy and immunotherapy for six weeks.
Doktori su otkrili i da mu je prostata jako uvećana, pa je imao još jednu operaciju.
Doctors also discovered that his prostate was very enlarged, so he had another operation.
Frakes je rekao da bi se bolest mogla proširiti da nije brzo reagovao.
Frakes said that the illness could have spread if he had not reacted quickly.
Urolog je objasnio da je krv u urinu, čak i bez bola, uvijek znak za uzbunu.
The urologist explained that blood in the urine, even without pain, is always a warning sign.
Glumac je o bolesti odlučio javno govoriti da bi ljudi bez čekanja otišli doktoru kada primijete promjene.
The actor decided to talk publicly about the illness so that people would go to a doctor without waiting when they notice changes.

title: Oluja na Dan zahvalnosti ostavila Amerikance bez struje
Storm on Thanksgiving left Americans without power
body: Jaka oluja pogodila je istočnu obalu SAD-a u četvrtak, na Dan zahvalnosti.
A strong storm hit the east coast of the USA on Thursday, on Thanksgiving Day.
Više od 920.000 domaćinstava ostalo je bez struje, a mnogi letovi su kasnili ili su otkazani.
More than 920,000 households were left without power, and many flights were delayed or cancelled.
Oluja je došla u vrijeme kada mnogi ljudi putuju zbog praznika.
The storm came at a time when many people travel because of the holiday.
Najviše domaćinstava bez struje bilo je u Pennsylvaniji, oko 226.000, zatim u Marylandu i Virginiji.
The most households without power were in Pennsylvania, about 226,000, then in Maryland and Virginia.
Do 18 sati po lokalnom vremenu kasnilo je više od 2.000 letova, a 428 je otkazano.
By 6 pm local time more than 2,000 flights were delayed, and 428 were cancelled.
Na aerodromu u Baltimoreu otkazan je svaki četvrti let.
At the airport in Baltimore every fourth flight was cancelled.
U New Jerseyju su ulice bile poplavljene, a u Ocean Cityju vjetar je odnio krov jedne zgrade.
In New Jersey the streets were flooded, and in Ocean City the wind blew away the roof of a building.
Meteorolozi su još u srijedu upozorili na poplave, jak vjetar i obilnu kišu.
Meteorologists warned already on Wednesday about floods, strong wind and heavy rain.
Zbog vjetra je čuvena parada Macy's u New Yorku prvi put u historiji odgođena za subotu.
Because of the wind, the famous Macy's parade in New York was postponed to Saturday for the first time in history.
Gradonačelnik Zohran Mamdani rekao je da udari vjetra mogu dostići oko 97 kilometara na sat.
Mayor Zohran Mamdani said that wind gusts could reach about 97 kilometres per hour.
Od 24. do 30. novembra očekuje se oko 17,6 miliona putnika na aerodromima.
From 24 to 30 November about 17.6 million passengers are expected at airports.

title: Osvojio milion dolara na lutriji, a onda ga uhapsio ICE
He won a million dollars in the lottery, then ICE arrested him
body: Muškarac iz Bostona osvojio je milion dolara na lutriji, ali je nekoliko dana kasnije uhapšen.
A man from Boston won a million dollars in the lottery, but a few days later he was arrested.
Zove se Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales, a uhapsila ga je američka imigracijska služba ICE.
His name is Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales, and he was arrested by the US immigration service ICE.
Lutrija je ranije na društvenim mrežama objavila njegovu fotografiju s velikim čekom.
The lottery had earlier published his photo with a big cheque on social media.
Dobitak je osvojio na srećki koju je kupio za 10 dolara.
He won the prize on a scratch ticket that he bought for 10 dollars.
Odlučio je odmah uzeti 650.000 dolara prije poreza, umjesto isplate u ratama.
He decided to take 650,000 dollars before tax at once, instead of payment in instalments.
Nekoliko dana kasnije ured ICE-a u Bostonu objavio je istu fotografiju i vijest o hapšenju.
A few days later the ICE office in Boston published the same photo and the news of the arrest.
Uhapšen je u utorak u istom dijelu grada u kojem je kupio srećku.
He was arrested on Tuesday in the same part of the city where he bought the ticket.
ICE kaže da je muškarac iz Salvadora i da je u SAD ušao ilegalno 2013. godine.
ICE says that the man is from El Salvador and that he entered the USA illegally in 2013.
Sudija je 2014. godine odlučio da mora napustiti zemlju.
In 2014 a judge decided that he must leave the country.
Fox News piše da je pokušao pobjeći, ali su ga brzo uhvatili.
Fox News writes that he tried to run away, but they quickly caught him.
Sada čeka deportaciju, a još se ne zna šta će biti s novcem.
He is now waiting for deportation, and it is not yet known what will happen to the money.

title: Trump kaže da je tražio od Putina povlačenje iz Evrope
Trump says he asked Putin to withdraw from Europe
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump objavio je da je od Vladimira Putina tražio da Rusija povuče svu vojnu agresiju u Evropi.
US President Donald Trump announced that he had asked Vladimir Putin for Russia to withdraw all military aggression in Europe.
Kaže da je to rekao Putinu prošle sedmice na samitu APEC-a u Kini.
He says he told Putin this last week at the APEC summit in China.
Nije objasnio na koja područja u Evropi misli.
He did not explain which areas in Europe he means.
Trump je napisao da je mirovni sporazum između Rusije i Ukrajine vrlo moguć.
Trump wrote that a peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine is very possible.
Dodao je da svakog mjeseca umiru hiljade ljudi.
He added that thousands of people die every month.
Objavu je napisao nakon sastanka s generalnim sekretarom NATO-a Markom Rutteom na Mar-a-Lagu.
He wrote the post after a meeting with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte at Mar-a-Lago.
U zajedničkoj izjavi rekli su da Rusija ne smije raditi ništa što bi proširilo rat.
In a joint statement they said that Russia must not do anything that would widen the war.
Agencija AFP piše da je ovo nova promjena tona, jer je Trump prošle sedmice Putina nazvao prijateljem.
The AFP agency writes that this is a new change of tone, because Trump called Putin a friend last week.
Poljska u isto vrijeme optužuje Rusiju da su dvije rakete i jedan dron pali na njenu teritoriju, a Moskva to negira.
At the same time Poland accuses Russia that two missiles and a drone fell on its territory, and Moscow denies it.
Ukrajinski predsjednik Volodimir Zelenski upozorio je da Rusija sprema novi veliki napad na energetski sistem.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is preparing a new large attack on the energy system.

title: Policija u Batumiju uzela navijaču Bešiktaša zastavu Palestine
Police in Batumi took a Palestinian flag from a Beşiktaş fan
body: Gruzijska policija ušla je na tribinu stadiona u Batumiju prije utakmice Evropske lige.
Georgian police entered the stand of the stadium in Batumi before a Europa League match.
Jedan navijač Bešiktaša razvio je zastavu Palestine, a nakon toga je došlo do kratkog sukoba.
A Beşiktaš fan unfurled a Palestinian flag, and after that there was a short clash.
Bešiktaš je igrao protiv izraelskog kluba Hapoel Beer Sheva u petom kolu.
Beşiktaš played against the Israeli club Hapoel Beer Sheva in the fifth round.
Video s tribine brzo se proširio na društvenim mrežama.
A video from the stand quickly spread on social networks.
Na snimku se vidi kako policajci ulaze među navijače, a onda počinje guranje.
The recording shows police officers going in among the fans, and then pushing begins.
Turski listovi Milliyet i Akşam pišu da je policija navijaču uzela zastavu.
The Turkish papers Milliyet and Akşam write that the police took the flag from the fan.
Utakmica se igra u Gruziji jer turske vlasti kažu da u Istanbulu ne bi bila sigurna.
The match is being played in Georgia because the Turkish authorities say that it would not be safe in Istanbul.
UEFA je zato izabrala stadion u Batumiju, a utakmica je počela u 18:45.
UEFA therefore chose the stadium in Batumi, and the match started at 18:45.
Navijači su smjeli doći na stadion.
Fans were allowed to come to the stadium.

title: Zašto teže spavamo u tuđoj kući i kako to promijeniti
Why we sleep worse in someone else's house and how to change it
body: Mnogi ljudi teško zaspu kada su u gostima kod porodice ili prijatelja, posebno za praznike.
Many people find it hard to fall asleep when they are guests at family's or friends' homes, especially over the holidays.
Stručnjaci za spavanje kažu da mozak u nepoznatom prostoru ostaje na oprezu.
Sleep experts say that the brain stays on alert in an unfamiliar space.
Magazin Real Simple zato je objavio nekoliko korisnih savjeta.
The magazine Real Simple therefore published several useful tips.
Prvo treba razgovarati s domaćinom o tome kada svi idu spavati.
First you should talk with the host about when everyone goes to sleep.
Dobro je odmah pronaći kupatilo i prekidače za svjetlo, jer se tako mozak lakše smiri.
It is good to find the bathroom and light switches right away, because that way the brain calms down more easily.
Ako možete, ponesite svoj jastuk, a sobu napravite što tamnijom.
If you can, bring your own pillow, and make the room as dark as possible.
Soba bi trebala biti hladnija, a dobra temperatura je oko 18 stepeni.
The room should be cooler, and a good temperature is about 18 degrees.
Stručnjaci savjetuju i da sat prije spavanja smanjite svjetlo i čitate.
Experts also advise that an hour before sleep you dim the light and read.
Poznati mirisi, na primjer vaš gel za tuširanje, također mogu pomoći.
Familiar smells, for example your shower gel, can also help.
Najvažnije je da ne pritiskate sebe, jer nekoliko loših noći nije velik problem.
The most important thing is not to pressure yourself, because a few bad nights are not a big problem.

title: Radomir Saičić bit će kandidat studenata za predsjednika Srbije
Radomir Saičić will be the students' candidate for president of Serbia
body: Studentski plenumi odlučili su da Radomir Saičić bude kandidat Studentske liste za predsjednika Srbije.
Student plenums decided that Radomir Saičić should be the Student List's candidate for president of Serbia.
Predsjednički izbori u Srbiji bit će održani 27. decembra.
The presidential election in Serbia will be held on 27 December.
Predsjednik parlamenta Aleksandar Čupić danas je raspisao te prijevremene izbore.
The speaker of parliament Aleksandar Čupić today called this early election.
Plenumi su dobili samo jedan prijedlog, a to je bilo Saičićevo ime.
The plenums received only one proposal, and that was Saičić's name.
Ranije se spominjala i jedna žena, ali ona nije htjela biti kandidatkinja.
Earlier one woman had also been mentioned, but she did not want to be the candidate.
Studentska lista će ime službeno objaviti u petak, 27. novembra.
The Student List will officially announce the name on Friday, 27 November.
U nedjelju počinje skupljanje potpisa za njegovu kandidaturu.
On Sunday the collection of signatures for his candidacy begins.
Saičić je profesor na Hemijskom fakultetu u Beogradu i član Srpske akademije nauka i umjetnosti.
Saičić is a professor at the Faculty of Chemistry in Belgrade and a member of the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts.
Bio je kandidat Studentske liste i na parlamentarnim izborima, kada je 25. oktobra proglasio pobjedu liste.
He was also the Student List's candidate in the parliamentary election, when he declared the list's victory on 25 October.
Politolog Stefan Surlić rekao je da je Saičić ozbiljan kandidat za predsjednika.
Political scientist Stefan Surlić said that Saičić is a serious candidate for president.

title: Advokati kažu da Mustafići nisu dio kriminalne grupe
Lawyers say the Mustafićs are not part of a criminal group
body: Advokati Mesuda i Mustafe Mustafića rekli su za Klix.ba da njihovi klijenti negiraju sve optužbe.
The lawyers of Mesud and Mustafa Mustafić told Klix.ba that their clients deny all the charges.
Oni su uhapšeni u akciji „Emisar“, zajedno s Naserom Orićem, Nikolinom Šljivić i Sinišom Dergancem.
They were arrested in the operation "Emisar", together with Naser Orić, Nikolina Šljivić and Siniša Derganc.
Tužilaštvo Republike Srpske traži pritvor za svih pet osumnjičenih.
The Prosecutor's Office of Republika Srpska is seeking custody for all five suspects.
Tužilaštvo tvrdi da je Orić organizovao grupu koja je trebala pomoći Đorđu Ždrali i Daliboru Bartuli da pobjegnu.
The prosecution claims that Orić organised a group that was supposed to help Đorđe Ždrale and Dalibor Bartula escape.
Mustafići su osumnjičeni za udruživanje u kriminalnu grupu i za pomaganje u pokušaju ubistva.
The Mustafićs are suspected of joining a criminal group and of helping in an attempted murder.
Tužilaštvo kaže da bi mogli pobjeći ili uticati na svjedoke.
The prosecution says that they could escape or influence witnesses.
Advokati Abdulah Kešan i Anel Ibeljić rekli su da njihovi klijenti nikada nisu bili osuđeni.
The lawyers Abdulah Kešan and Anel Ibeljić said that their clients have never been convicted.
Mustafa ima 18 godina i učenik je srednje škole, a obojica žive na stalnoj adresi.
Mustafa is 18 years old and a secondary school student, and both live at a permanent address.
Advokati smatraju da za pritvor nema razloga i da bi bile dovoljne blaže mjere.
The lawyers believe that there is no reason for custody and that milder measures would be enough.
Ročište je bilo zatvoreno za javnost, a sud još nije donio odluku.
The hearing was closed to the public, and the court has not yet made a decision.

title: Klix Vremeplov dobio 23.000 starih vijesti i osmanske novine
Klix Vremeplov gets 23,000 old news stories and Ottoman newspapers
body: Arhiv starih novina Klix Vremeplov danas je dobio sedam novih novina i više od 23.000 vijesti.
The archive of old newspapers Klix Vremeplov today got seven new newspapers and more than 23,000 news stories.
Sada u arhivu ima 25 novina, a čitaoci mogu tražiti tekstove po riječi, datumu, mjestu i novinama.
There are now 25 newspapers in the archive, and readers can search texts by word, date, place and newspaper.
Sav materijal dolazi iz digitalne zbirke Nacionalne i univerzitetske biblioteke BiH.
All the material comes from the digital collection of the National and University Library of BiH.
Prvi put u arhivu su i novine na osmanskom turskom jeziku, pisane arapskim pismom.
For the first time, the archive also has newspapers in the Ottoman Turkish language, written in Arabic script.
To su sarajevske novine Vatan i Rehber, a tekstove je prevela umjetna inteligencija.
These are the Sarajevo newspapers Vatan and Rehber, and the texts were translated by artificial intelligence.
Vatan je izlazio svakog petka od 1884. do 1897. godine, i u arhiv je ušlo svih 640 brojeva.
Vatan came out every Friday from 1884 to 1897, and all 640 issues went into the archive.
Prijevode nije provjerio stručnjak, zato je originalni tekst uvijek najvažniji.
The translations were not checked by an expert, so the original text is always the most important.
Vatan je pisao i o gradnji sarajevske Vijećnice.
Vatan also wrote about the building of the Sarajevo City Hall.
Gradsko vijeće je 1891. godine odlučilo da gradi novu zgradu, a ona je na kraju koštala 500.000 forinti.
The city council decided in 1891 to build a new building, and in the end it cost 500,000 forints.
Novine su pisale i o prvom tramvaju, novoj katedrali i željeznici od Sarajeva do Konjica.
The newspaper also wrote about the first tram, the new cathedral and the railway from Sarajevo to Konjic.
Prema popisu iz 1885. godine, Sarajevo je tada imalo 27.124 stanovnika.
According to a census from 1885, Sarajevo then had 27,124 inhabitants.

title: Vučić: Zvezda i Partizan više neće dobijati državni novac
Vučić: Zvezda and Partizan will no longer get state money
body: Bivši predsjednik Srbije Aleksandar Vučić rekao je da Crvena zvezda i Partizan više neće dobijati novac od države.
Former Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić said that Crvena zvezda and Partizan will no longer get money from the state.
To je izjavio na Informer TV-u, nakon promjene vlasti u Srbiji.
He said this on Informer TV, after the change of government in Serbia.
Vučić je sada šef poslaničke grupe „Srbija pobeđuje“ u parlamentu.
Vučić is now head of the parliamentary group "Srbija pobeđuje" in parliament.
Studentska lista je pobijedila na parlamentarnim izborima, pa se očekuju promjene u finansiranju sportskih klubova.
The Student List won the parliamentary elections, so changes are expected in the funding of sports clubs.
Najveće promjene mogle bi pogoditi košarkaške klubove Zvezde i Partizana.
The biggest changes could hit the basketball clubs of Zvezda and Partizan.
Vučić je rekao da će od iduće godine klubovi imati velikih problema s novcem.
Vučić said that from next year the clubs will have big problems with money.
Priznao je da su klubovi dobijali više novca nego što su zaslužili svojim rezultatima.
He admitted that the clubs got more money than they had earned with their results.
Ipak je rekao da mu nije žao, jer je to bila dobra promocija zemlje.
Still, he said that he is not sorry, because it was good promotion for the country.
Dodao je da je on kriv što ih je razmazio, a da su kritike studenata u tome bile tačne.
He added that he is to blame for spoiling them, and that the students' criticism was correct on this.

title: Dodik oštro kritikovao rezoluciju Evropskog parlamenta o Vukovaru
Dodik sharply criticised the European Parliament's resolution on Vukovar
body: Evropski parlament je danas usvojio rezoluciju o Vukovaru.
The European Parliament today adopted a resolution on Vukovar.
Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik ubrzo je na mreži X oštro kritikovao taj dokument.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik soon sharply criticised that document on the network X.
Rekao je da rezolucija mijenja historiju i da je dio politike protiv Srba.
He said that the resolution changes history and that it is part of a policy against Serbs.
Rezolucija između ostalog traži od Srbije da otvori svoje arhive.
Among other things, the resolution asks Serbia to open its archives.
Tako bi se moglo saznati šta se desilo s 1.725 nestalih osoba.
That way it could be found out what happened to 1,725 missing persons.
Vukovar je pao 18. novembra 1991. godine, nakon tri mjeseca opsade JNA i srpskih paravojnih jedinica.
Vukovar fell on 18 November 1991, after a three-month siege by the JNA and Serb paramilitary units.
Nakon toga su na Ovčari ubijeni zarobljenici i ranjenici iz vukovarske bolnice.
After that, prisoners and wounded people from the Vukovar hospital were killed at Ovčara.
Dodik je zločin u Vukovaru nazvao „jednom epizodom rata“.
Dodik called the crime in Vukovar "one episode of the war".
Pitao je zašto parlament nije donio rezoluciju o Jasenovcu i o srpskim izbjeglicama.
He asked why the parliament had not passed a resolution on Jasenovac and on Serb refugees.
Hrvate je optužio za genocid, a Nijemce je nazvao njihovim „mentorima“.
He accused Croats of genocide, and he called the Germans their "mentors".
Na kraju je rekao da Srbi više neće šutjeti.
At the end he said that Serbs will no longer stay silent.

title: Privrednici u Splitu skupili novac za koncert Dine Merlina
Businesspeople in Split raised money for a Dino Merlin concert
body: Ugostitelji i privrednici iz Splita skupili su više od 70 posto novca za koncert Dine Merlina.
Restaurant owners and businesspeople from Split have raised more than 70 percent of the money for a Dino Merlin concert.
Koncert bi trebao biti održan 30. decembra na splitskoj Rivi.
The concert is supposed to be held on 30 December on Split's Riva.
Honorar za pjevača je plaćen, ali još nedostaje novac za produkciju.
The singer's fee has been paid, but money for the production is still missing.
Organizatori nisu rekli koliko su novca skupili ni koliko im ukupno treba.
The organisers did not say how much money they have raised or how much they need in total.
Ljudi uplaćuju novac preko platforme Adriaticket, a imena donatora bit će objavljena.
People pay the money through the Adriaticket platform, and the names of the donors will be published.
Akciji su se pridružili i hotelijeri, a koncert bi trebao imati i humanitarni dio.
Hotel owners have also joined the campaign, and the concert is supposed to have a charity part as well.
Akcija je počela nakon što je gradonačelnik Splita Tomislav Šuta odustao od ugovora za koncert.
The campaign started after Split mayor Tomislav Šuta withdrew from the contract for the concert.
Više od 20.000 građana potpisalo je peticiju da se novac da za novi medicinski aparat za bolnicu.
More than 20,000 citizens signed a petition for the money to be given for a new medical device for the hospital.
Grad je ranije rekao da bi honorar bio 140.000 eura, a produkcija 160.000 eura.
The city had earlier said that the fee would be 140,000 euros and the production 160,000 euros.
Tim Dine Merlina još nije komentarisao akciju.
Dino Merlin's team has not yet commented on the campaign.

title: WhatsApp uvodi zakazivanje poruka za sve korisnike
WhatsApp introduces message scheduling for all users
body: WhatsApp je zvanično uveo zakazivanje poruka, funkciju koju korisnici često traže.
WhatsApp has officially introduced message scheduling, a feature that users often ask for.
Zakazivanje znači da poruku napišete sada, a ona bude poslana kasnije.
Scheduling means that you write a message now, and it is sent later.
Do sada je funkcija bila dostupna samo nekim korisnicima Android aplikacije, a u narednim sedmicama dobit će je svi.
Until now the feature was available only to some users of the Android app, and in the coming weeks everyone will get it.
Korisnik treba držati dugme za slanje, a onda izabrati datum i vrijeme.
The user needs to hold the send button and then choose a date and time.
Poruke se mogu zakazati najmanje 10 minuta i najviše 14 dana unaprijed.
Messages can be scheduled at least 10 minutes and at most 14 days in advance.
Tako se mogu slati tekst, fotografije i video, u privatnim i grupnim razgovorima.
Text, photos and video can be sent this way, in private and group chats.
Osoba koja dobije poruku ne vidi da je poruka bila zakazana.
The person who receives the message does not see that the message was scheduled.
Prema WhatsAppu, poruka će otići u pravo vrijeme čak i ako je telefon ugašen.
According to WhatsApp, the message will go at the right time even if the phone is switched off.
Korisnici mogu vidjeti sve zakazane poruke i obrisati ih prije slanja.
Users can see all scheduled messages and delete them before sending.
Kompanija kaže da su poruke zaštićene i da ih ona ne može čitati.
The company says that the messages are protected and that it cannot read them.

title: Poništen tender FUP-a od 4 miliona KM za popravku helikoptera
FUP's 4 million KM tender for a helicopter repair cancelled
body: Federalna uprava policije (FUP) poništila je tender za remont, odnosno veliki servis, jednog helikoptera.
The Federal Police Administration (FUP) cancelled a tender for the overhaul, that is, a major service, of one helicopter.
Riječ je o helikopteru Bell 206L-1 Long Ranger.
It is a Bell 206L-1 Long Ranger helicopter.
Obavijest o tome objavljena je danas.
The notice about it was published today.
Tender je poništen 11. novembra, nakon odluke Ureda za razmatranje žalbi.
The tender was cancelled on 11 November, after a decision by the Procurement Review Office.
U obavijesti ne piše ko je uložio žalbu niti zašto je ona prihvaćena.
The notice does not say who filed the appeal or why it was accepted.
Tender je raspisan 24. augusta, a vrijedio je oko 4 miliona KM s PDV-om.
The tender was announced on 24 August, and it was worth about 4 million KM with VAT.
FUP je htio potpisati ugovor na 36 mjeseci s firmom koja ponudi najnižu cijenu.
FUP wanted to sign a 36-month contract with the company that offered the lowest price.
Helikopter je vraćen u BiH iz Srbije 2010. godine.
The helicopter was returned to BiH from Serbia in 2010.
Vlada FBiH dala ga je FUP-u na korištenje 2017. godine.
The FBiH government gave it to FUP for use in 2017.
Od povratka stoji u hangaru, a nije poznato hoće li FUP raspisati novi tender.
Since its return it has been standing in a hangar, and it is not known whether FUP will announce a new tender.

title: Sudiju optužili da je pijan, a njemu je pao šećer
Referee accused of being drunk, but his blood sugar had dropped
body: Sirijski sudija Hanna Hattab zamijenjen je na poluvremenu utakmice azijske Lige prvaka 2.
Syrian referee Hanna Hattab was replaced at half-time of an Asian Champions League 2 match.
Igrali su Al Jazira iz Emirata i iranski klub Gol Gohar.
Al Jazira from the Emirates and the Iranian club Gol Gohar were playing.
Iranski klub je tvrdio da je sudija bio pijan.
The Iranian club claimed that the referee was drunk.
U 32. minuti Hattab je dao žuti karton golmanu Al Jazire, iako golman nije učestvovao u faulu.
In the 32nd minute Hattab gave a yellow card to the Al Jazira goalkeeper, although the goalkeeper had not taken part in the foul.
Odluku je promijenio tek nakon razgovora s četvrtim sudijom.
He changed the decision only after talking to the fourth official.
Gol Gohar je prijetio da neće nastaviti utakmicu ako Hattab ostane, pa je u drugom poluvremenu sudio četvrti sudija.
Gol Gohar threatened not to continue the match if Hattab stayed, so the fourth official refereed the second half.
Snimci s utakmice brzo su se proširili društvenim mrežama.
Videos from the match quickly spread on social networks.
Iranski novinar Erfan Hoseiny sada tvrdi da je sudiji pao šećer u krvi, pa je izgubio koncentraciju.
Iranian journalist Erfan Hoseiny now claims that the referee's blood sugar dropped, so he lost concentration.
Rekao je da je ljekarski pregled nakon utakmice pokazao da alkohola nije bilo.
He said that a medical check after the match showed there was no alcohol.
Azijska nogometna konfederacija (AFC) još nije dala izjavu.
The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has not yet made a statement.

title: Helez opet pomjerio rok za turske dronove, sada do Nove godine
Helez moves the deadline for Turkish drones again, now by New Year
body: Ministar odbrane BiH Zukan Helez rekao je da bi turski dronovi Bayraktar TB2 trebali stići do Nove godine.
BiH Defence Minister Zukan Helez said that the Turkish Bayraktar TB2 drones should arrive by the New Year.
To je izjavio na konferenciji za medije pred Dan Oružanih snaga BiH, 1. decembra.
He said this at a press conference ahead of the Day of the Armed Forces of BiH on 1 December.
Rok je pomjeren već nekoliko puta, a ranije je najavljivao mart pa kraj maja 2026.
The deadline has already been moved several times, and earlier he had announced March and then the end of May 2026.
Do Nove godine trebala bi stići i oklopna vozila Kirpi 2 i sistem za zaštitu od dronova.
Kirpi 2 armoured vehicles and an anti-drone system should also arrive by the New Year.
Helez je rekao da je kupljeno 6 novih helikoptera, a 60 pilota se obučava u Turskoj i SAD-u.
Helez said that 6 new helicopters had been bought, and 60 pilots are training in Turkey and the US.
Plate u vojsci i ministarstvu porast će za 13,7 posto.
Salaries in the army and the ministry will rise by 13.7 percent.
Za četiri godine vojska je primila oko 4.000 novih ljudi, od toga oko 750 ove godine.
In four years the army has taken on about 4,000 new people, about 750 of them this year.
O dronovima se govori više od dvije godine, a 2024. je najavljeno da stižu u januaru 2025.
The drones have been talked about for more than two years, and in 2024 it was announced they would arrive in January 2025.
Isporuku je kasnije usporio PDV, porez koji se plaća i na vojnu opremu koja se dobije kao poklon.
The delivery was later slowed by VAT, a tax that is also paid on military equipment received as a gift.
Helez je rekao i da je vojska BiH spremna poslati jedinice u mirovnu misiju u Gazi.
Helez also said that the BiH army is ready to send units to a peacekeeping mission in Gaza.

title: Mnogo policije ispred suda u Banjoj Luci zbog ročišta Oriću
Many police outside the court in Banja Luka over Orić hearing
body: Ispred Okružnog suda u Banjoj Luci danas su raspoređene jake policijske snage.
Strong police forces were deployed outside the District Court in Banja Luka today.
U sudu se održava ročište za Nasera Orića i još četiri osobe.
A hearing for Naser Orić and four other people is being held in the court.
Neki policajci su nosili i duge cijevi, odnosno puške.
Some police officers were also carrying long-barrelled weapons, that is, rifles.
Ročište je trebalo početi ujutro, ali je pomjereno na 12:15, a novinari nisu smjeli ući u sudnicu.
The hearing was supposed to start in the morning, but it was moved to 12:15, and journalists were not allowed into the courtroom.
Tužilaštvo Republike Srpske traži pritvor za Orića, Nikolinu Šljivić, Mesuda i Mustafu Mustafića i Sinišu Derganca.
The Prosecutor's Office of Republika Srpska is seeking custody for Orić, Nikolina Šljivić, Mesud and Mustafa Mustafić and Siniša Derganc.
O tome će odlučiti sudija za prethodni postupak.
A pre-trial judge will decide on that.
Pritvor znači da bi osumnjičeni ostali u zatvoru dok traje istraga.
Custody means that the suspects would stay in prison while the investigation lasts.
Petorica osumnjičenih su uhapšeni jer se sumnja da su pomagali Đorđu Ždrali.
The five suspects were arrested because they are suspected of helping Đorđe Ždrale.
Ždrale je osumnjičen za pokušaj ubistva Koste Pandurevića i za njim je raspisana međunarodna potjernica.
Ždrale is suspected of the attempted murder of Kosta Pandurević, and an international arrest warrant has been issued for him.
Akciju „Emisar“ provela je policija RS-a, uz pomoć SIPA-e.
The police of RS carried out the operation "Emisar" with the help of SIPA.

title: Evropski parlament traži od Srbije da otvori arhive o Vukovaru
European Parliament asks Serbia to open its archives on Vukovar
body: Evropski parlament je danas u Strasbourgu usvojio rezoluciju o Vukovaru.
The European Parliament adopted a resolution on Vukovar in Strasbourg today.
Povod je 35. godišnjica pada i razaranja tog hrvatskog grada.
The occasion is the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of that Croatian city.
To je prva rezolucija koja govori samo o stradanju Vukovara.
It is the first resolution that is only about the suffering of Vukovar.
Rezoluciju je predložio hrvatski zastupnik Karlo Ressler, a potpisali su je svi hrvatski zastupnici i petero kolega iz drugih zemalja.
Croatian MEP Karlo Ressler proposed the resolution, and all Croatian MEPs and five colleagues from other countries signed it.
Hrvatska još traži 1.725 nestalih osoba, pa parlament traži od Srbije da otvori svoje arhive.
Croatia is still looking for 1,725 missing people, so the parliament is asking Serbia to open its archives.
U tekstu se spominju i zločini na Ovčari i logori koje je vodila JNA.
The text also mentions the crimes at Ovčara and the camps run by the JNA.
Parlament osuđuje svako negiranje ratnih zločina i veličanje ratnih zločinaca.
The parliament condemns any denial of war crimes and glorification of war criminals.
Glasanje su s balkona pratili stanovnici Vukovara i porodice nestalih.
Residents of Vukovar and families of the missing watched the vote from the balcony.
Ljiljana Alvir, koja vodi udruženje porodica nestalih, rekla je da rezolucija daje novu malu nadu.
Ljiljana Alvir, who leads an association of families of the missing, said that the resolution gives new, small hope.
Studenti u Srbiji su prije glasanja rekli da rezolucija zanemaruje srpske žrtve.
Students in Serbia said before the vote that the resolution ignores Serbian victims.
Predsjednica parlamenta Roberta Metsola poslat će tekst vladama u EU i na Zapadnom Balkanu.
Parliament President Roberta Metsola will send the text to governments in the EU and the Western Balkans.

title: Preminuo sarajevski grafičar i profesor Avdo Žiga
Sarajevo printmaker and professor Avdo Žiga has died
body: U 74. godini preminuo je Avdo Žiga, poznati grafičar i profesor Akademije likovnih umjetnosti u Sarajevu.
Avdo Žiga, a well-known printmaker and professor at the Academy of Fine Arts in Sarajevo, has died at the age of 74.
Grafičar je umjetnik koji pravi otiske slika s ploča od metala, drveta ili kamena.
A printmaker is an artist who makes prints of images from plates of metal, wood or stone.
Dženaza će biti u petak, 27. novembra, u 13:30 na mezarju Vlakovo.
The funeral will be on Friday, 27 November, at 13:30 at Vlakovo cemetery.
Žiga je rođen u Sarajevu 1953. godine, a sarajevsku Akademiju je završio 1978.
Žiga was born in Sarajevo in 1953, and he graduated from the Sarajevo Academy in 1978.
Postdiplomski studij završio je u Beogradu, a 1986. je učio tehniku bakroreza u Parizu.
He completed postgraduate studies in Belgrade, and in 1986 he studied the technique of copper engraving in Paris.
Njegovi radovi bili su na mnogim izložbama u BiH i u inostranstvu.
His works were shown at many exhibitions in BiH and abroad.
U Umjetničkoj galeriji BiH 2017. je pokazano više od 50 njegovih grafika.
More than 50 of his prints were shown at the Art Gallery of BiH in 2017.
Dugo je na Akademiji predavao grafiku i crtanje i bio mentor mnogim studentima.
For a long time he taught printmaking and drawing at the Academy and mentored many students.
Bio je i predsjednik Udruženja likovnih umjetnika BiH.
He was also president of the Association of Fine Artists of BiH.
U tekstu se navodi da je njegov rad ostavio veliki trag na umjetničkoj sceni Sarajeva i BiH.
The article says that his work left a big mark on the art scene of Sarajevo and BiH.

title: SDA bira kandidate, Nezir Pivić mogući novi premijer FBiH
SDA picks candidates, Nezir Pivić possible new FBiH prime minister
body: Stranka demokratske akcije (SDA) danas i sutra bira svoje kandidate za najvažnije funkcije u novoj vlasti.
The Party of Democratic Action (SDA) is choosing its candidates for the most important posts in the new government today and tomorrow.
Danas se sastaje kolegij stranke, a sutra kadrovska komisija i predsjedništvo SDA.
The party's leadership board meets today, and the personnel commission and the SDA presidency meet tomorrow.
Oni trebaju potvrditi kandidate za vlast u Federaciji BiH i na državnom nivou.
They are to confirm the candidates for the government in the Federation of BiH and at state level.
Za premijera FBiH najvjerovatnije će biti predložen Nezir Pivić, sadašnji premijer Zeničko-dobojskog kantona.
Nezir Pivić, the current prime minister of Zenica-Doboj Canton, will most likely be proposed for FBiH prime minister.
Razmatran je i Suad Huskić, bivši načelnik Tešnja, ali Pivić ima prednost.
Suad Huskić, the former mayor of Tešanj, was also considered, but Pivić has the advantage.
SDA će predložiti i kandidate za rukovodstvo parlamenata, a konstituirajuće sjednice zakazane su za 1. decembar.
SDA will also propose candidates for the leadership of the parliaments, and the inaugural sessions are scheduled for 1 December.
Očekuje se da u novoj vladi FBiH budu i HDZ, Stranka za BiH i DF.
HDZ, the Party for BiH and DF are expected to be in the new FBiH government as well.
Razgovori o programu rada još traju, pa nije sigurno ko će na kraju formirati vladu.
Talks on the work programme are still going on, so it is not certain who will form the government in the end.
SDA poručuje da je SDP dobrodošao u vlast na državnom nivou, ali da u FBiH treba promijeniti neke kadrove.
SDA says that SDP is welcome in the state-level government, but that it should change some of its people in the FBiH.
Uloga SDP-a mogla bi zavisiti i od optužnica protiv Vojina Mijatovića i Nermina Nikšića.
SDP's role could also depend on the indictments against Vojin Mijatović and Nermin Nikšić.
Više bi se trebalo znati sljedeće sedmice.
More should be known next week.

title: Kineski leteći automobil uskoro ide u masovnu proizvodnju
Chinese flying car is soon going into mass production
body: Kineski proizvođač automobila Xpeng pokazao je leteće vozilo u svom sjedištu u gradu Guangzhou.
Chinese carmaker Xpeng showed a flying vehicle at its headquarters in the city of Guangzhou.
Vozilo se zove Land Aircraft Carrier, a razvila ga je Xpengova firma Aridge.
The vehicle is called Land Aircraft Carrier, and it was developed by Xpeng's company Aridge.
Letjelica je poletjela iznad zgrada kompanije i sletjela na platformu pred novinarima.
The aircraft took off above the company's buildings and landed on a platform in front of journalists.
Proizvod ima dva dijela: kombi sa 6 točkova i malu letjelicu koja stoji u njegovom prtljažniku.
The product has two parts: a van with 6 wheels and a small aircraft that sits in its boot.
